I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It passes `wj run --verify` on Example 1, where the interpreter and the compiled build both print `1 2 3 6 9 8 7 4 5` and exit 0.

I did not run Example 2 or any malformed-input cases, so the `error` paths and the non-square case are untested. I also didn't run `wj check` separately. `--verify` built it without complaint.

The program prints the spiral by walking
